program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can persistent Characters remain reachable, inspectable and creator-editable beyond the current Scene while preserving Scene membership/selection, Character identity and exact return semantics without creating a permanent People silo or inventing casting/Performer mechanics?
inherited_law: Whole-Production Character management must exist without making People a mandatory top-level silo.
Character identity is persistent and distinct from Performer/provider assignment.
Off-Scene inspection/editing must not silently alter current Scene membership or selection.
Creator edits are not fictional Character actions.
Focus, selection and scope remain distinct; Back/Close is navigation rather than Undo.
Light and Dark preserve one semantic system; no Stage successor is created.

design_result.access_rule: Whole-Production Character reach is a deliberate Production-scope capacity; everyday Shaping remains situation-first.
design_result.scope_rule: Management selection is local to the Production-level surface and does not replace the stored current-Scene selection.
design_result.membership_rule: Opening, selecting, editing or creating a persistent Character does not imply add/remove/current-Scene participation.
design_result.identity_rule: Persistent Character identity remains stable across Scene presence, off-Scene state and Performer/provider assignment changes.
design_result.creator_edit_rule: Persistent Character edits are creator-authority work and never become fictional Character action, memory, refusal or performance.
design_result.creation_rule: Architecture reserves persistent Character creation without freezing Scene participation, casting, lifecycle, merge/delete/archive or duplicate semantics.
design_result.return_rule: Close/Back restores the prior current Scene, stored Scene selection and originating focus target; effective persistent edits remain effective.
design_result.responsive_rule: wide list+detail adjacency -> medium overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential list/detail/deep-inspection while scope and origin remain invariant.
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark preserve identical Production/Scene scope and selection semantics

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: The heading 'Persistent cast' could imply casting/Performer mechanics rather than persistent Character identity.
corrections: Changed both Light/Dark headings from 'Persistent cast' to 'Persistent Characters' and reran the complete browser/visual audit.

non_authority: Exact Production-Character surface label, commands, create/edit affordances and field groupings remain provisional.
Exact Scene add/remove/participation, casting, lifecycle, duplicate/merge/delete/archive semantics remain Product-defined.
Exact Performer/provider/model assignment and availability policy remain open.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons, portraits, imagery, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail causal/history inspection inside the frozen shell, preserving current-versus-historical distinction, semantic origin and exact return without creating a permanent Archive/History mode.
